summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and refactored the three ignite handlers to delegate to them, as specified. Nothing was run: tests and flake8 are unverified. Changes: new monai/data/csv_saver.py and monai/data/nifti_saver.py; plot function added to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py (existing GIF helpers unchanged); SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler rewritten as thin adapters (index inserted before max_channels, filename inserted before overwrite, output_path renamed to output_dir); NIfTI writer default dtype changed to np.float32; output_path callers updated in two examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. New tests: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py; test_handler_classification_saver.py updated to pass filename. Also added the two data modules to docs/source/data.rst, which the spec did not ask for. Nothing was committed. Open items: run the test suite and flake8 to confirm; the classification handler's ignite 0.3.0 attach and the plot GIF path are the most likely places for surprises.
